description: This file defines the RegistrationAPIClientService class, which provides methods to create an HTTP client and publish registration data via an API call, including error handling and logging.

classes.name: RegistrationAPIClientService
classes.description: A service class providing API client setup and data publishing functionality with error handling.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Guzzle HTTP client configured for the registration API.

methods.name: publishData
methods.description: Sends registration data to the registration API endpoint; returns true if successful, logs errors otherwise.
